messages:
tess: Heads-up: saw a perf regression after the SM87 fingerprint change. On a subset of nodes (redwood-3*), kernel picker is choosing generic matmul path at seqlen=64 -> KV cache thrash + ~15% p50 on text-gen. Logs below.

Tess: ```
[2026-01-25T12:13:19Z] kernel_picker: inspected hw_sig=0x3a sm=87 cuda=12.2
[2026-01-25T12:13:19Z] pick: generic_mm_v3 (reason: tc_probe=false)
[2026-01-25T12:13:19Z] runtime: seqlen=64 batch=1 kv_cache_evictions=12
``` 

runtime-bot: Deploy bot: sm87-detect rollout to cluster-redwood-3 completed at 1769999300 :white_check_mark:

omar: Can you paste the kernel-selection dump (the full predictor output)? Also what driver version on those nodes?

tess: curl https://debug.internal/redwood-3/kernel_choice | sed -n '1,40p' -> snippet below

tess: GPU: sm=87 cuda=12.2 driver=540.2 tensor_cores_probe=false bf16=true fp8=false hw_sig=0x3a

tess: predictor dump: chosen_path=generic_mm_v3; special_paths_tried=[tc_fast, tc_fallback]; tc_probe_result=false; heur_score={seqlen:64:0.22, seqlen:128:0.6}

jay: I think the debouncer that flips on `tensor_cores_probe` is mis-evaluating due to a known probe bug on driver 540.x — we saw false-negatives there earlier. That would explain tc_probe=false despite SM>=80 and BF16=true.

omar: can we reproduce with the microbench on redwood-3? repro cmd:

omar: ```bash
python infra/tools/run_kernel_probe.py --node redwood-3 --seqlen 64 --reps 80 --batch 1
```

tess: running now; also attaching perf snapshot from the gen-small job around the spike window

tess: ```
p50 baseline: 42ms -> current: 48ms (+14.3%)
eviction_rate: baseline 0.4/sec -> current 3.1/sec
CPU wait: small
```

runtime-bot: Perf alert: p50 increased 14% on job `gen-small` between 1769998900-1769999400 — investigation label added

jay: Proposed mitigation: change picker to treat `tensor_cores_probe=false` as inconclusive for SM>=80 when BF16==true. If probe false but hw_sig suggests TC present, try `tc_approx` kernel for seqlen<=128 as a canary. Rollout on 10% of ded pool.

omar: sounds reasonable. Also add quick KV-cache metric guard: if eviction_rate spikes >2/sec after switch, auto-fallback to previous path.

tess: Agreed. Two items: (1) patch picker with TC-debounce and canary path, (2) infra test matrix: batch 1..8 x seqlen 32/64/128 measuring tokens/sec and kv-evict-rate. I'll open an issue with the test matrix and link the repro logs.

omar: I'll run the matrix on a pinned node and post results in this thread. ETA ~30m.

jay: I'll draft PR for picker change + feature flag `sm87_tc_debounce` so we can toggle quickly.

tess: Thanks. Tagging @eng-infra for node access + @eng-sre for alerting threshold review :eyes:

tess: thanks all :thumbsup:
